newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: WAPET close to joint NW Shelf LNG expansion-Texaco.
newsitem.headline: WAPET close to joint NW Shelf LNG expansion-Texaco.

text.p: Partners in the West Australian Petroleum Pty Ltd (WAPET) consortium are very close to delivering a proposal for joint expansion of the North West Shelf gas project and WAPET's undeveloped Gorgon gas field, one of the partners, Texaco Inc, said on Tuesday.
"I am talking in terms of a couple of weeks," Michael Mahon, chairman and managing director of Texaco Oil Development Co, told Reuters.

Mahon was responding to a report in the West Australian newspaper that West Australian Resources Minister Colin Barnett had renewed attacks on the North West Shelf and WAPET partners for "indecision" over liquefied natural gas (LNG) development plans.
In a letter to the Gorgon partners about two weeks ago Barnett expressed concern at their failure to make a development decision on the A$10 billion LNG project, the paper said.
The report said Barnett also believed the North West Shelf partners could advance the start-up date for their fourth and fifth LNG trains currently set at 2003.
